position_margin.basis: measured against clean data by dinocorpus: the margin is ABSOLUTE and applied to each of k positions with no multiplicity correction, so on clean 4-option data a dataset trips S3 by chance 16.3% of the time at 20 items, 8.7% at 24, 3.3% at 30 and 0.4% at 50. min_choice_items=20 admits the noisiest end of that. Not retuned on one measurement; S3 warns and never gates, and the warning now states the rate at the size it fired on. Full curve: D-046.

length_margin.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

uncheckable_warn.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

guess_margin.basis: found live: a 1B model answering one label constantly sat at exactly chance and pooling hid it

min_choice_items.basis: 20 keyed choice items before position or length skew

min_checkable.basis: 20 records before a per-model rate is worth reporting

min_leak_len.basis: 2 characters before a target is long enough to 'appear' in a question

dropped_rows_max.basis: 1% of a file being unauditable is the line between housekeeping and a structural problem. Empirical basis: all 31 fetched benchmark corpora drop ZERO rows, so any material drop is unusual rather than routine

near_dup_bits.basis: 5 of 64 bits is conventional in the perceptual-hash literature, and is now MEASURED against a human annotation: on ciFAIR's hand-labelled CIFAR-10 duplicates it recovers 28.1% of them (70 of 249) and flags 158 test/train pairs across 60,000 images, while every byte-level check recovers 0%. 8 bits nearly doubles recall to 52.6% for 3.2x the candidates and starts flagging images the annotators judged similar but NOT duplicates. The default stays at 5: that curve is one dataset of 32x32 photographs, and it is not a licence to reset a default for documents or spectrograms. Full curve: N-017, and `benchmarks/cifair/compare.py --sweep` re-derives it.

kr20_min.basis: 0.5 is the low end of what psychometrics calls usable reliability; 0.7+ is the textbook bar and would skip most fleets

negative_discrimination.basis: item analysis treats r_pb below about -0.2 as a candidate key error

dead_weight_max.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

min_fleet.basis: 4 examinees before fleet statistics are attempted

min_fleet_discrimination.basis: measured: 0/5 detections at 6 examinees, 5/5 at 40, on 200 items with 10% of keys inverted

min_fleet_agree.basis: 3 models before unanimity is a word worth using

min_fleet_dimension.basis: 6 examinees before a second axis is worth asking after; dimensionality needs more spread than reliability does

dimension_margin.basis: measured: at 0.10 above the fixed-margins null, 0/10 false alarms on unidimensional fleets and 0/10 misses on 2- and 3-cluster specialised fleets, at 6, 8 and 10 examinees

min_items_per_subskill.basis: 5 items per declared subskill before its within-group coherence is more than noise

min_items_psycho.basis: 5 common items before a matrix means anything

spend_tolerance_usd.basis: floating-point slack on a money comparison

candidate_list_min.basis: 3 other answer-space values before a question counts as offering a candidate list

ordering_flip_rate.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

bootstrap_trials.basis: how many resamples a bootstrap draws

ceiling_acc.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

floor_acc.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

min_dynamic_range.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

escape_margin.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

escape_min_rate.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

shortcut_z.basis: 3 sigma against the per-item chance null, the usual bar for calling a surface feature real

shortcut_lift.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

target_leak_nmi.basis: 0.5 normalized mutual information: a column that resolves half the target's entropy is worth a human's eye. A candidate, not a verdict; only the author knows if it exists at predict time

collapse_margin.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

blind_lift_min.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

collapse_exclude_share.basis: 95% identical before a model is called constant

seed_spread_min.basis: a practical floor beneath the noise band, so a significant 2-point move at huge n is not reported as a finding

min_billed_chars.basis: below 40 characters chars/4 is too noisy to bill against

billing_ratio_max.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

order_swing_min.basis: same practical floor, for presentation order

template_swing_min.basis: same practical floor, for instruction framing

noise_z.basis: 1.96 standard errors is the 95% two-sided normal quantile

contains_target_max.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

min_scored_misses.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

ece_max.basis: 0.10 is ten points of stated confidence the accuracy does not back; Guo et al. 2017 report 0.05 to 0.17 for uncalibrated deep nets and under 0.03 after temperature scaling, so the bar sits between a fixable habit and an honest number

prose_answer_words.basis: 6 words at the median: a proper noun or a canonical title rarely runs longer, a sentence-length free-text answer almost always does, so this is where exact match stops testing capability and starts testing wording. A candidate, not a verdict

key_skew_margin.basis: 0.10 above a balanced key's 1/k: enough that always guessing the majority answer is a real strategy, not the parity a well-built key aims for. A candidate for the author's eye, not a defect; a real base rate can be skewed

global_label_max.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

label_reuse_min.basis: 10 items per distinct answer on average: a classification set reuses its few labels heavily (emotion is ~333), open QA does not (TriviaQA is ~2), so this is where a small answer space stops being per-item keys and becomes a label vocabulary S2 should not read as leakage

ungrounded_max.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

min_grounding_evidence.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

underreport_ratio.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

redundant_call_max.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

judge_agreement_min.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

self_preference_max.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

judge_inconsistency_max.basis: author judgment; no derivation or calibration on record

construct_validity.why: This battery checks mechanical integrity: that the data is not self-incriminating, the scorer can fail, the runs are honest, the numbers survive noise, and the claims have their evidence. None of that establishes that the eval measures what its author means it to measure. A trivial eval, a mis-aimed eval, and a saturated eval can all pass every check here.
construct_validity.what_would: construct validity is argued, not computed: task analysis, comparison against an external criterion, and evidence that the score moves with the ability it claims to track. No tool can hand you that, and one that implied it could would be the worst instrument in this repository.
